definitions.title: Parametric Surface and Normal Vector
definitions.latex: \mathbf{r}(u, v) = x(u, v)\mathbf{i} + y(u, v)\mathbf{j} + z(u, v)\mathbf{k}, \quad \mathbf{n} = \mathbf{r}_u \times \mathbf{r}_v
definitions.statement: A smooth parametric surface S is traced by continuous vector function r(u, v) over parameter domain R in the uv-plane. The cross product of tangent vectors r_u and r_v provides the normal vector.
definitions.explanation: Coordinates u and v form curvilinear coordinate grid lines on the curved 2D surface in 3-space.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Parametrization provides an intrinsic coordinate system for arbitrary 3D surfaces.

definitions.title: Surface Area Differential and Formula
definitions.latex: d\sigma = |\mathbf{r}_u \times \mathbf{r}_v| \, du \, dv, \quad \text{or for } z = f(x, y): \; d\sigma = \sqrt{1 + f_x^2 + f_y^2} \, dA
definitions.statement: The surface area element d sigma measures the area of the infinitesimal parallelogram spanned by tangent increments r_u du and r_v dv. Total surface area is the double integral of d sigma over the parameter region.
conditions: Surface is smooth and traversed once
definitions.explanation: For Monge explicit patch z = f(x, y), simplifies to sqrt(1 + (dz/dx)^2 + (dz/dy)^2) dx dy.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Quantifies area of curved 2D manifolds embedded in 3D Euclidean space.
